    67	- Main-thread work on a visible row update is proportional to the changed visible
    68	  rows, not all rows.
    69	- Scroll-time work is bounded by the viewport and nearby lazy rows.
    70	- Test/proof extraction never runs as a normal SwiftUI accessibility value.
    71	- Automation state is still deterministic, structured, and strict enough to
    72	  catch UI drift.
    73	- The architecture has one owner for publish eligibility and one owner for
    74	  automation snapshots, so future code cannot reintroduce bulk payloads in view
    75	  bodies.
    76	
    77	## Proposed Shape For Model Critique
    78	
    79	Create a central `DockRenderPipeline` concept owned by the Dock screen layer.
    80	It should replace ad hoc "publish every combined snapshot" behavior with a
    81	single place that decides whether a new host event changes the rendered Dock
    82	screen.
    83	
    84	The pipeline has three products:
    85	
    86	1. `DockScreenModel`: small, Equatable, main-actor state for SwiftUI.
    87	2. `DockRenderDataset`: off-main full-row data used by projection, search,
    88	   filters, grouping, and details.
    89	3. `DockAutomationSnapshot`: structured, on-demand proof data for UI tests and
    90	   sync scripts.
    91	
    92	The important rule: `DockView` can render `DockScreenModel`, but it must not
    93	derive all-row automation payloads from body evaluation.
    94	
    95	## Central Patterns To Introduce
    96	
    97	### 1. Publish Gate
    98	
    99	Add a single publish gate before `DockScreenStore` emits `.loaded`.
   100	
   101	Inputs:
   102	
   103	- Current rendered screen fingerprint.
   104	- Next host snapshot metadata.
   105	- Next combined projection fingerprint.
   106	- Pending local UI overlays such as optimistic renames.
   107	- Current projection options: lens, search, filters, collapsed groups.
   108	
   109	Outputs:
   110	
   111	- `skip`: no visible or automation-relevant screen change.
   112	- `metadataOnly`: update connectivity/status side channels without invalidating
   113	  the Dock row tree.
   114	- `publish`: emit a new `DockScreenModel`.
   115	
   116	The gate should reject heartbeat-only publishes when the ordered visible row IDs
   117	and row display fingerprints are unchanged.
   118	
   119	### 2. Stable Row Display Fingerprints
   120	
   121	Each `DockRowViewModel` needs a compact fingerprint that represents only fields
   122	that can change rendered row UI or row automation truth:
   123	
   124	- identity: host, source host, projection ID, thread ID
   125	- display ordering key
   126	- status/origin/relationship
   127	- repository, branch, label presence, color rail
   128	- summary/title/last activity text used on the row
   129	- pin state and pinned ordering fields
   130	
   131	The fingerprint is the comparison primitive. The UI should not diff whole
   132	payload strings.
   133	
   134	### 3. Viewport-Bounded SwiftUI Contract
   135	
   136	Keep `LazyVStack`, but make the state SwiftUI observes smaller:
   137	
   138	- `DockScreenModel` contains summary/header/filter state, visible row section
   139	  identities, and row view models needed for the current projection.
   140	- Rows remain individually identified by stable row identity.
   141	- Expensive all-row proof data and full encoded `rowValues` do not live in
   142	  `DockView`.
   143	
   144	The plan should decide whether `DockScreenModel` still carries all projected
   145	rows for `LazyVStack` or whether it introduces an indexed collection/view model
   146	that supports viewport-window extraction. The default preference is minimal:
   147	first remove bulk accessibility work and no-op publishes, then add true windowing
   148	only if profiling still shows total-row render cost.
   149	
   150	### 4. Automation Snapshot Service
   151	
   152	Replace Dock root `rowValues=` with a centralized test/proof path.
   153	
   154	Candidate shape:
   155	
   156	- `DockAutomationSnapshotStore` owned next to `DockScreenStore`.
   157	- It receives accepted `DockRenderSnapshot` values off the main interaction path.
   158	- It exposes compact screen state on the root accessibility value:
   159	  `loaded; rows=1247; visibleRows=1247; revision=26; automationSnapshot=26`.
   160	- UI tests and simulator proof scripts fetch full row proof data through a
   161	  dedicated, explicitly test-only route.
   162	
   163	The route could be:
   164	
   165	- A hidden accessibility element with paged/chunked row payloads created only
   166	  when `CODEX_DOCK_UI_TESTING=1`.
   167	- A simulator-only app-container JSON snapshot written by the app when
   168	  `CODEX_DOCK_UI_TESTING=1`.
   169	- A local app diagnostic endpoint only in UI-test launch mode.
   170	
   171	The model-consensus pass must choose the smallest robust route and specify how
   172	scripts/tests migrate.
   173	
   174	### 5. Performance Budget Tests
   175	
   176	Add tests that fail when regressions reappear:
   177	
   178	- Unit test the publish gate: heartbeat/no-row-change does not publish.
   179	- Unit test row fingerprints: display-relevant changes publish; invisible
   180	  metadata-only changes do not.
   181	- Unit test root accessibility value length stays bounded at high row count.
   182	- UI performance proof: with 1,200+ rows and both hosts, no all-row
   183	  accessibility rebuilds occur during idle/scroll.
   184	- Contract proof migration: displayed-UI sync still has one strict Dock truth
   185	  path, but it is no longer the root accessibility string.
   186	
   187	## What Should Be Deleted Or Replaced
   188	
   189	The final plan must include a real retirement list, not just additions.
   190	
   191	Delete or replace:
   192	
   193	- `DockView.dockScreenValue` all-row `rowValues=` construction.
   194	- `DisplayedUICaptureSupport.dockRowsFromRootValue(...)` as the only row truth
   195	  parser.
   196	- README/docs claims that Dock row identity/order are read from Dock root
   197	  `rowValues=`.
   198	- Any UI test assumption that a normal visible accessibility value should carry
   199	  all Dock rows.
   200	- Any per-call/manual publish filtering outside the central publish gate.
   201	
   202	Keep:
   203	
   204	- Stable `AutomationID.Dock.row(...)` identifiers on row views.
   205	- Per-row `accessibilityValue(row.automationValue)` if profiling proves it is
   206	  viewport-bounded and does not force all-row work.
   207	- Existing `RenderCoalescer` if the central pipeline can absorb it cleanly.
   208	- Existing `DockCardProjection` semantics unless model consensus finds a simpler
   209	  owner split.
   210	
   211	## Open Questions For Consensus
   212	
   213	- Should automation proof move to a simulator-only file snapshot, a hidden
   214	  paged accessibility snapshot, or another existing proof channel?
   215	- Should the first implementation keep all projected row models in
   216	  `DockScreenModel`, or introduce explicit viewport/window state now?
   217	- Does publish gating belong in `DockStore`, `DockScreenStore`, or a new
   218	  `DockRenderPipeline` object that owns both projection and equality?
   219	- Which existing instrumentation should stay as permanent regression telemetry,
   220	  and which should be deleted after the fix?
   221	- What is the exact minimal deletion/migration path so there is never both an
   222	  old root `rowValues` oracle and a new automation oracle active long-term?
   223	
   224	## Current Best Bet Before Consensus
   225	
   226	The smallest elegant fix is probably:
   227	
   228	1. Move all publish eligibility into one `DockRenderPipeline`.
   229	2. Add display fingerprints and skip unchanged rendered projections.
   230	3. Replace root `rowValues=` with a test-mode `DockAutomationSnapshotStore`.
   231	4. Keep UI state as normal SwiftUI row arrays for now.
   232	5. Add explicit performance-budget tests so no future feature can put all-row
   233	   payloads back into body/accessibility work.
   234	
   235	This bet is intentionally provisional. The model-consensus pass must critique
   236	it against the repo evidence and either simplify it or replace it.

**Recommendation**
✅ Use a single Dock accessibility payload, e.g. `codexdock.dock.renderedRows`.

Make it accessible to XCUITest but visually nonintrusive. Do **not** use `.accessibilityHidden(true)`, because then XCTest may not see it. The root value should keep scalar state only: loaded/count/lens/search/filter status.

Why this is smallest:
- Current root already builds the strict row payload from rendered projection rows in [DockView.swift](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDock/Features/Dock/DockView.swift:1087).
- The UI sampler already emits `dockRows` JSONL in [DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDockUITests/DisplayedUICaptureSupport.swift:454).
- The Node proof already compares only `sample.dockRows` against relay truth in [dock-relay-simulator-ui-sync-proof.mjs](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/scripts/dock-relay-simulator-ui-sync-proof.mjs:1358).
- Makefile proof targets can stay unchanged because they already pass `--ui-samples` to the comparator in [Makefile](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/Makefile:499).

❌ Simulator/app-container JSON: too much new plumbing and a weaker proof route. Existing app-container copying is for diagnostics only in [Makefile](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/Makefile:272), and diagnostics live under app support in [ClientObservabilityStore.swift](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/CodexDock/Diagnostics/ClientObservabilityStore.swift:308). See [worklog](/Users/aelaguiz/workspace/codex-client/docs/IPHONE_17_PRO_DOCK_LAG_PROFILE_WORKLOG_2026-06-04.md:1057).
